rows.question: Is adult dental care covered?
rows.headline: Routine adult dental care is not covered by your plan.

rows.question: I'm 34. Will the plan pay for a teeth cleaning at the dentist?
rows.headline: Routine teeth cleanings are not covered for members age 19 and older.

rows.question: What does clause 7.3(b) say?
rows.headline: Clause 7.3(b) states that routine dental care is not covered for members age 19 and older.

rows.question: Do I need prior authorization for an MRI?
rows.headline: You need prior authorization for non-emergency MRIs.

rows.question: My knee MRI will cost $1,800 and I haven't paid anything toward my deductible yet. What will I pay?
rows.headline: Your knee MRI is covered if you get prior authorization, and you will pay the full $1,800 toward your deductible.

rows.question: What happens if I see an out-of-network doctor and nobody gets prior authorization?
rows.headline: If you use an out-of-network provider and do not get required prior authorization, your benefits are reduced by 50%.

rows.question: I broke my arm while on vacation in Spain. Am I covered?
rows.headline: Emergency and urgent care for your broken arm while in Spain are covered.

rows.question: If I get seriously sick abroad, will the plan pay to fly me back home to the US?
rows.headline: Medical evacuation and repatriation back to the United States are not covered by your plan.

rows.question: Is Wegovy covered if my doctor prescribes it for weight loss?
rows.headline: Wegovy is not covered when it is prescribed primarily for weight loss.

rows.question: Is Ozempic covered for my type 2 diabetes?
rows.headline: Ozempic is covered for type 2 diabetes, but you need prior authorization first.

rows.question: How much does an emergency room visit cost me?
rows.headline: An emergency room visit costs a $400 copay per visit, and your deductible does not apply.

rows.question: Do I still pay the ER copay if I end up being admitted to the hospital?
rows.headline: You do not have to pay the emergency room copay if you are admitted to the hospital as an inpatient.

rows.question: How many physical therapy sessions can I get this year?
rows.headline: Your plan covers up to 30 physical therapy visits per plan year, combined with occupational and speech therapies.

rows.question: Does the plan cover IVF?
rows.headline: Your plan does not cover in vitro fertilization (IVF).

rows.question: Can I get LASIK eye surgery covered?
rows.headline: LASIK eye surgery is not covered by your plan.

rows.question: Is therapy for anxiety covered, and is there a limit on sessions?
rows.headline: Therapy for anxiety is covered by your plan, and there is no limit on the number of in-network visits.

rows.question: Is my yearly checkup free?
rows.headline: Your yearly checkup is free when you see a network provider.

rows.question: Can my 24-year-old son stay on my plan?
rows.headline: Your 24-year-old son can stay on your plan because children under age 26 are eligible for coverage.

rows.question: My claim was denied. How long do I have to appeal?
rows.headline: You have 180 days to file an internal appeal after receiving a claim denial notice.

rows.question: I'm 45. Are hearing aids covered?
rows.headline: Hearing aids are not covered for members age 19 and older under your policy.

rows.question: Is acupuncture covered?
rows.headline: Acupuncture is covered only for chronic low back pain, up to 12 visits per plan year.

rows.question: Will insurance pay for a nose job to change how my nose looks?
rows.headline: Your plan does not cover a nose job done to change your appearance.

rows.question: What is my deductible?
rows.headline: Your in-network deductible is $3,000 per person ($6,000 per family), and your out-of-network deductible is $6,000 per person ($12,000 per family).

rows.question: What's the most I could pay in a year?
rows.headline: The most you could pay for covered in-network services in a year is $8,500 per person or $17,000 per family.

rows.question: Is an ambulance ride covered?
rows.headline: Ambulance rides are covered if they are medically necessary and for an emergency.

rows.question: Can I see an out-of-network chiropractor?
rows.headline: Out-of-network chiropractic care is not covered by your plan.

rows.question: How much do I pay for insulin?
rows.headline: Insulin costs $35 for a 30-day supply, and your deductible does not apply.

rows.question: Is my newborn baby covered automatically?
rows.headline: Yes, your newborn baby is covered automatically for the first 31 days after birth.

rows.question: I had surgery at an in-network hospital but the anesthesiologist was out-of-network. Can they bill me extra?
rows.headline: Your plan covers your care, and federal rules protect you from extra balance billing by an out-of-network anesthesiologist at an in-network facility.

rows.question: Does the plan pay for my new glasses? I'm 30.
rows.headline: Your plan does not cover eyeglasses for members age 19 and older.

rows.question: Does this plan pay for repairs to my car?
rows.headline: I couldn't find anything about this in your policy.

rows.question: Can you recommend a good pizza place nearby?
rows.headline: I couldn't find anything about this in your policy.

rows.question: Is my dog's vet visit covered?
rows.headline: I couldn't find anything about this in your policy.

rows.question: What's the stock price of Evergreen Mutual?
rows.headline: I couldn't find a stock price for Evergreen Mutual in your policy.
